snippet.title: Key Fairy | Frosty Games Fest 2025
snippet.description:
Featured in Frosty Games Fest 2025! Watch the full showcase here: https://youtu.be/3ff3YxX7Cgw

Step into the forest with us for a moment, as we take a look at Key Fairy, a hand-drawn, folkloric, pacifist bullet-hell where you’ll dance around monsters, speak with strange folk, and evade forgotten gods. This trailer features gameplay and story elements, but most importantly reveals the first ever public demo available now on Steam!

Wishlist: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2878580/Key_Fairy/ 

Find more games made in Australia and Aotearoa New Zealand on our Steam event page here: https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45423962/sale/FrostyGamesCelebration  

#frostygamesfest #gaming #indiegames #madeinanz
